args.description: 读取 batch-video-ingestion skill 文件
执行 batch-video-ingestion skill 的完整测试链路
args.command:
mkdir -p /mnt/user-data/outputs/batch-video-ingestion /mnt/user-data/workspace/batch-video-ingestion
python - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
videos = {"videos":[{"video_id":"video-traffic-agent-test","camera_id":"CAM_DEERFLOW_001","file_path":"/mnt/datasets/Vedio-demo/Trafic.mp4","source_type":"local_file","capture_seconds":2,"metadata":{"filename":"Trafic.mp4","location":{"city":"宁波市","district":"奉化区"}}}]}
p = pathlib.Path('/mnt/user-data/workspace/batch-video-ingestion/videos.json')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
json.dump(videos, p.open('w'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
PY
python /mnt/skills/custom/batch-video-ingestion/scripts/run.py --manifest-json /mnt/user-data/workspace/batch-video-ingestion/videos.json --index citybrain-video-library --config /mnt/skills/custom/configs/deerflow_config.json --refresh --output /mnt/user-data/outputs/batch-video-ingestion/result.json

args.description: 读取 batch-video-ingestion 执行结果
重新执行并捕获完整输出
args.command:
mkdir -p /mnt/user-data/outputs/batch-video-ingestion /mnt/user-data/workspace/batch-video-ingestion && python - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
videos = {"videos":[{"video_id":"video-traffic-agent-test","camera_id":"CAM_DEERFLOW_001","file_path":"/mnt/datasets/Vedio-demo/Trafic.mp4","source_type":"local_file","capture_seconds":2,"metadata":{"filename":"Trafic.mp4","location":{"city":"宁波市","district":"奉化区"}}}]}
p = pathlib.Path('/mnt/user-data/workspace/batch-video-ingestion/videos.json')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
json.dump(videos, p.open('w'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
print("videos.json created")
PY
python /mnt/skills/custom/batch-video-ingestion/scripts/run.py --manifest-json /mnt/user-data/workspace/batch-video-ingestion/videos.json --index citybrain-video-library --config /mnt/skills/custom/configs/deerflow_config.json --refresh --output /mnt/user-data/outputs/batch-video-ingestion/result.json 2>&1
